title: Day and Trial Passes: eligibility to record a visit
content:
This document states the basis on which a visit is recorded against a Day and Trial Passes pass (Single Day Pass, Three-Day Trial Pass, Seven-Day Trial Pass, Weekly Visitor Pass, Monthly Trial Pass, Corporate Guest Pass).

## Rule
A visit may be recorded only while the pass is active. In addition, no more than the tier's daily visit limit counts toward usage in a single calendar day; visits beyond that tier's daily visit limit on the same calendar day do not count toward usage.

## Eligibility checklist
- What is checked: the company's own current record of that pass's status, correlated to the same pass on which the visit is being recorded.
- When it is checked: before the visit is recorded.
- What satisfies it: the pass's recorded status is active.
- What does not satisfy it: the pass's recorded status is applied, expired, or closed.

### Positive and negative cases (hypothetical)
- A pass recorded as active at the moment of check-in: the visit may be recorded.
- A pass recorded as expired, or already closed by cancellation, conversion, or archival, at the moment of check-in: the visit may not be recorded.
